display.usage: H1, H2 display headlines, hero rotating words

text.usage: Subtitles, body copy, card titles, navigation, buttons

radii.hero_block: 32px top/right, 64px rounded bottom-left corner (Brevo signature shape)

button_specs.primary: Solid near-black ink background (#0D150C), accent text on hover, rounded-2xl (16px), px-6 py-3.5, font-medium
button_specs.secondary: Outlined ink-2 border, semi-transparent background, rounded-2xl (16px), px-6 py-3.5
button_specs.cta: Brevo-style high contrast primary CTA placed on tinted background block

card_specs.shadow: Subtle hover lift (-translate-y-1) with soft ambient shadow

motion_rules.transitions: Explicit property transitions only: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease (NEVER transition: all)
motion_rules.rotating_word: Vertical slide & fade animation cycling through 'calls' -> 'leads' -> 'bookings' -> 'texts'
motion_rules.app_previews: Live-style micro-animated elements inside browser/mobile device frames (typing indicators, call waves, audio pulsing)

illustration_style_prompt: Clean vector 3D flat-hybrid editorial SaaS illustrations for virtual telephony and cloud communications. Vibrant parrot-green accents (#1FA84F) with soft warm sage greens, clay whites, and soft mint shadows. Smooth rounded geometry, minimal isometric perspective, clean lines without black strokes, representing voice waves, mobile device frames, AI call routing nodes, and landline text bubbles in a unified, modern tech aesthetic matching Brevo style.

key_functionalities_and_sections.brand_identity: Keep CloudIVR logo (green parrot icon + wordmark)
key_functionalities_and_sections.mega_menu: Products mega menu grouping Calling (Browser phone, SIP), Automation (IVR keypad, Bulk IVR, Quick IVR), Texting (Landline to Texting), and AI (AI Voice Agents, Text-to-Voice)
key_functionalities_and_sections.hero_section: Outcome headline with rotating word (calls -> leads -> bookings -> texts), tinted hero block (#C0FFA5) with large rounded bottom-left corner, left-aligned hero copy, proof chip, solid near-black primary CTA, outlined secondary CTA, layered UI card preview on right
key_functionalities_and_sections.trust_strip: True facts proof strip: 17 countries supported, free test call available, crypto/wallet payments, EN/ES/FR multi-language support
key_functionalities_and_sections.value_pillars: 3 pillars: 'Every call answered', 'Automate outreach', 'AI that talks for you' with matching custom vector illustrations
key_functionalities_and_sections.channel_slider: Interactive channel slider showcasing Browser Phone, SIP Trunking, Texting, AI Voice Agents, and Quick IVR
key_functionalities_and_sections.product_tour_tabs: Tabbed interactive feature preview with device frames and live animated previews
key_functionalities_and_sections.use_cases: Targeted use cases for E-commerce, Local Services, Sales Outreach, Healthcare & Booking
key_functionalities_and_sections.how_it_works: 3 simple steps: 1. Choose Number, 2. Pick Workflow / AI Agent, 3. Go Live
key_functionalities_and_sections.pricing_teaser: 4 plans teaser: Starter ($50), Pro ($75), Business ($120), Texting Plan / Landline to Texting ($200 setup + $50/mo standalone)
key_functionalities_and_sections.faq_section: Accordion FAQ covering setup, landline texting, crypto wallet payments, and international numbers
key_functionalities_and_sections.final_cta: Full-width Brevo-style tinted CTA banner with bold headline and conversion button
key_functionalities_and_sections.footer: Multi-column footer with product links, legal compliance, language switcher (EN/ES/FR), and dark mode toggle

instructions_to_main_agent.file_format: Use React JS files (.js / .jsx), not TypeScript (.tsx)
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, toggles) MUST include data-testid attributes
instructions_to_main_agent.header_style: Header background must use glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl with light/dark translucent background, never fully transparent
instructions_to_main_agent.css_theme_vars: Integrate theme variables cleanly with light (#F7FAF5 / #C0FFA5) and dark (#0A1109 / #173B14) mode support
